decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds on the firm's established machining offer and fits its push for smarter automation, so keeping it open costs little while its demand is still uncertain.
The dual-table loading system is a low-cost extension of the existing machines and supports the automation strategy, and one year of website presence is too little evidence to justify abandoning it.

The dispensing machine is a flagship with its own page and a Red Dot award, an early positive signal that justifies keeping this strategic growth option open while its market value in a new field becomes clearer.
